event.description: Share only the query map across two attention heads
event.proposal: Family: attention organization. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 13 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0020 at 3,168 parameters/99.94%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0122, whose key-shared two-head attention scored 0.00% at 1,593 parameters. Hypothesis: attempt-0122 failed specifically because distinct keys are needed to expose different memory features, while a shared query can still compare against both key heads. Preserve both full key heads and the full value transform, replace only the two query maps by their checkpoint-average 8x16 map, and share parameters across depth, yielding 1,593 parameters. This is more informative than sharing values next because it is the exact query/key complement of the measured failure at identical count and isolates which side of compatibility needs head-specific features. Causal softmax and generic decoding remain unchanged.
